def next_rand(state: int) -> int:
    """Advance a linear congruential generator one step.

    The result is in [0, 2147483648) for any state in that range.
    """
    pre state >= 0
    pre state < 2147483648
    post out >= 0
    post out < 2147483648
    ex next_rand(0) == 12345
    return (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return a permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed.

    The same xs and seed always give the same result. xs is not modified.
    """
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 1) == []
    ex shuffled([7], 3) == [7]
    ex shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 42) == shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 42)
    out = xs.copy()
    state = (seed % 2147483648 + 2147483648) % 2147483648
    i = out.len() - 1
    while i > 0:
        state = next_rand(state)
        j = state % (i + 1)
        tmp = out[i]
        out[i] = out[j]
        out[j] = tmp
        i -= 1
    return out
